Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: The server will, on each packet multicast, transmit this message for every second for which at least one application message is generated

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Second message will be disseminated for every second change where there is at least one payload message

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message is used to signal a market or trading period event.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Trade Date of event as applicable, if Event Code is “P” or “R”, applies to all active trade dates.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: See System Event Code Explanation below

Message.Name: Future Symbol Directory Message
Message.Description: As each product moves to the new Trade Date, ASX Trade24 will disseminate the future symbol messages defining the available futures, CFDs and Share Future contracts for each instrument. The action of disseminating this message will automatically imply the contract is in a “Pending” session state.

Field.Name: Exchange
Field.Description: Denotes the exchange identifier of the contract

Field.Name: Instrument
Field.Description: Denotes the instrument identifier of the contract

Field.Name: Expiry Year
Field.Description: Year of expiry (YYYY) for Contract Type “F”, zero otherwise

Field.Name: Expiry Month
Field.Description: Month of expiry for Contract Types, zero otherwise

Field.Name: Price Decimal Position
Field.Description: Position of the decimal point in the price

Field.Name: Last Trading Date
Field.Description: Last Trading Date and Time. Applicable to Contract Types “F” only, zero otherwise. Note where the time is defined, it is local time AEST or ADST depending if the expiry date is during AEST or ADST.

Field.Name: Financial Type
Field.Description: Indicates the how to valuate a contract.

Field.Name: Lot Size or Face Value
Field.Description: Size of each lot or face value of each lot

Field.Name: Maturity Value
Field.Description: Number of days or years to maturity for bills or bonds, Financial Type is “X” or “B”

Field.Name: Coupon Rate
Field.Description: Implied 2 decimal value indicating the coupon rate for bonds, e.g. 1234=12.34%, Financial Type is “X” only

Field.Name: Payments per Year
Field.Description: Number payments per year for bonds, Financial Type is “X” only

Message.Name: Spread Symbol Directory Message
Message.Description: As each product moves to the new Trade Date, ASX Trade24 will disseminate the spread symbol messages defining the available calendar spread and inter-spread contracts. For contracts that are inter-spreads, the underlying legs are in the same Trade Date.

Field.Name: Exchange
Field.Description: Denotes the exchange identifier of the contract.

Field.Name: First Leg Contract Number
Field.Description: Underlying Contract Number Field Element Identifier of the first contract leg.

Field.Name: Second Leg Contract Number
Field.Description: Underlying Contract Number Field Element Identifier of the second contract leg.

Field.Name: Primary Ratio
Field.Description: Ratio of the first contract leg.

Field.Name: Secondary Ratio
Field.Description: Ratio of the second contract leg.

Field.Name: Price Decimal Position
Field.Description: Position of the decimal point in the price.

Message.Name: Option Symbol Directory Message
Message.Description: As each product moves to the new Trade Date, ASX Trade24 will disseminate the option symbol messages defining all the available options contracts. For Single Session Options only, the exchange can activate or de-activate option symbols during the course of trading by issuing Order Book State messages for affected option contracts. If an option symbol is not active (Activated field is ‘N’) or is de-activated (Trading Status is “I”), reference to that option contract should be removed from the list of actively traded contracts. If an option symbol is active (Activated field is ‘Y’) or is activated (Trading Status is “A”), reference to that option contract should be added to the list of actively traded contracts.

Field.Name: Exchange
Field.Description: Denotes the exchange identifier of the contract.

Field.Name: Instrument
Field.Description: Denotes the instrument identifier of the contract.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Indicates the type of option “P” – Put Option or “C” – Call Option.

Field.Name: Underlying Contract Number
Field.Description: Underlying Future Contract Number (zero if Contract Type “E”).

Field.Name: Price Decimal Position
Field.Description: Position of the decimal point in the price.

Field.Name: Strike Price Decimal Position
Field.Description: Position of the decimal point in the price.

Field.Name: Strike Price Minimum Tick
Field.Description: Minimum tick size for the Strike Price.

Field.Name: Last Trading Date
Field.Description: Last Trading Date and Time is local time AEST or ADST depending if the expiry date is during AEST or ADST.

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Implied 3 decimal volatility for an option, i.e. 12345 is 12.345%.

Field.Name: Financial Type
Field.Description: Indicates the how to valuate a contract.

Field.Name: Lot Size or Face Value
Field.Description: Size of each lot or face value of each lot.

Field.Name: Maturity Value
Field.Description: Number of days or years to maturity for bills or bonds, Financial Type is “X” or “B”.

Field.Name: Coupon Rate
Field.Description: Implied 2 decimal value indicating the coupon rate for bonds, e.g. 1234=12.34%, Financial Type is “X” only.

Field.Name: Payments per Year
Field.Description: Number payments per year for bonds, Financial Type is “X” only.

Field.Name: Activated
Field.Description: For single session options only, “Y” indicates strike is active or is activated, “N” indicates strike is inactive or is deactivated.

Message.Name: Order Book State Message
Message.Description: ASX Trade24 uses this message to indicate the current session state of a contract to the market.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Indicates the current session state for the contract.

Message.Name: Order Added Message
Message.Description: An Order Added message indicates a new order has been accepted by the ASX Trade24 system and was added to the order book. All orders in ASX Trade24 are anonymous and one “Add” type is supported for “real” orders that are not custom market orders. The message is referenced by an Order Number assigned by ASX Trade24 and is unique for the life of the order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Order Number
Field.Description: Order number assigned by Matching Engine.

Field.Name: Order Book Priority
Field.Description: Time priority within the order book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of lots added to the book (all volume is visible).

Message.Name: Order Replaced Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order in the book has been modified for price or volume where the priority changes. Even though the side and contract number cannot be changed, these fields are included in the message to provide fast look-up.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Order Number
Field.Description: The order number of the order being replaced.

Field.Name: Order Book Priority
Field.Description: Time priority within the order book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of lots order is modified to (all volume is visible).

Message.Name: Order Volume Cancelled Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order in the book is modified as a result of a partial cancellation of volume. The difference between this message and the Order Replaced is an Order Replaced will always show a change of order book priority in regards to the order’s position in the queue. An Order Volume Cancelled message is not sent when an order has partially traded.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Order Number
Field.Description: The order number of the order being reduced.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of lots order is modified to (all volume is visible).

Message.Name: Order Deleted Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order in the book is cancelled by the owner, expired, cancelled by the exchange, purged or volume cancelled. All remaining volume is no longer accessible so the order must be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Order Number
Field.Description: The order number of the order being cancelled.

Message.Name: Implied Order Added Message
Message.Description: This message is the same format as the Order Added message, except the nature of this order is it has an implied price, implied volume and a priority that is derived from two or more spreadable “real” orders.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of implied order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Order Book Priority
Field.Description: Time priority within the order book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of implied lots added to the book (all volume is visible).

Message.Name: Implied Order Replaced Message
Message.Description: This message is the same format as the Order Replaced message, except this replacement refers to an implied order and is sent whenever the implied pricing or volume has changed due to a price or volume movement of “real” orders for a side of a single contract number.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of implied order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Order Book Priority
Field.Description: Time priority within the order book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of implied lots added to the book (all volume is visible).

Message.Name: Implied Order Deleted Message
Message.Description: This message is the same format as the Order Deleted message, except this deletion refers to an implied order. When received, any implied volume is no longer accessible so the “implied” order of the indicated side must be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of implied order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Order Number
Field.Description: Reference number of the implied order.

Message.Name: Custom Market Order Added Message
Message.Description: Any resting Custom Market Order that trades will be reported using the Custom Market Executed or Custom Market Trade message.

Field.Name: Order Book Priority
Field.Description: Time priority within the custom order book.

Field.Name: Contract Legs
Field.Description: Contract Legs for Custom Market Order

Message.Name: Custom Market Order Replaced Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order in the custom market book has been modified for volume. Custom market order modification messages always include the Order Number of the Custom Market Order Added to which the update applies. To determine the current display volume for an order, subscribers must replace the original volume stated in the Custom Market Order Added message with the quantity stated in the Custom Market Order Replaced message of the same order number.

Field.Name: Order Book Priority
Field.Description: Time priority within the custom market order book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of lots order is modified to (all volume is visible).

Message.Name: Custom Market Order Deleted Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order in the custom market book is cancelled by the owner, expired, cancelled by the exchange or purged. All remaining volume is no longer accessible so the order must be removed from the book. A Custom Market Order Deleted message is not sent when an order has traded out.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever a resting order of the book is executed in whole or in part where the price and contract number of the order and trade are the same. It is possible to receive several Order Executed messages for the same order reference number if that order is executed in several parts.

Field.Name: Contract Number
Field.Description: Contract Number Field Element Identifier of Order Book Traded.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on Order after matching, if 0, order has traded out and should be deleted.

Message.Name: Order Executed with Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever two resting orders of the same contract are executed. This can occur in two circumstances: During levelling in whole or in part at a price that could be different from one or both resting order prices.

Field.Name: Contract Number
Field.Description: Contract Number Field Element Identifier of Order Book Traded.

Field.Name: Buyer Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on Order after matching, if 0 order has traded out and should be deleted.

Field.Name: Seller Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on Order after matching, if 0 order has traded out and should be deleted.

Message.Name: Spread Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever the open leg of a resting spread order is traded in whole or in part where the price and the contract number will be different than the traded contract number. It is possible to receive several Spread Executed messages for the same order number if that order is executed in several parts.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on Order after matching, if 0, order has traded out and should be deleted.

Field.Name: Traded Contract Number
Field.Description: Contract Number Field Element Identifier of the underlying Order Book Traded.

Field.Name: Spread Trade Price
Field.Description: If a spread-to-spread trade, this will be set to the spread price.

Field.Name: Trade Side of Leg
Field.Description: ‘B’ – Order Leg is Buyer, ‘S’ – Order Leg is Seller.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays: “N” = non-printable or “Y” = printable.

Message.Name: Trade Spread Execution Chain Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever two resting orders of different contracts are executed in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price(s) such as sweeping or spreading orders. Since the execution price is different than the display price of the original Add Order, a trade price field is included within the execution message.

Field.Name: Buyer
Field.Description: Buyer Contract Number Field Element Identifier.

Field.Name: Side of Buyer
Field.Description: Side of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Buyer Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on order after matching. If zero, order has traded out and should be deleted.

Field.Name: Seller Contract Number
Field.Description: Seller’s Contract Number Field Element Identifier.

Field.Name: Side of Seller
Field.Description: Side of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Seller Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on order after matching. If zero, order has traded out and should be deleted.

Field.Name: Traded Contract Number
Field.Description: Contract Number Field Element Identifier of the underlying Order Book Traded.

Field.Name: Spread Trade Price
Field.Description: If a spread-to-spread trade, this will be set to the spread price.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays: “N” = non-printable or “Y” = printable.

Message.Name: Custom Market Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever the open leg of a resting custom market order is traded in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on custom order after matching, if 0, order has traded out and should be deleted.

Field.Name: Traded Contract Number
Field.Description: Contract Number Field Element Identifier of the underlying Order Book Traded.

Field.Name: Trade Side of Leg
Field.Description: ‘B’ – Custom Leg is Buyer, ‘S’ – Custom Leg is Seller.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays: “N” = non-printable or “Y” = printable.

Message.Name: Custom Market Trade Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever a resting custom market order is matched with a resting non-custom market order executed in whole or in part at a price that could be different from the initial display price(s) such as spreading orders. Since the execution price could be different than the display price of the original Order Added, a trade price field is included within the execution message.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on order after matching. If zero, order has traded out and should be deleted.

Field.Name: Custom Market Order Number
Field.Description: Custom Market Order Reference number of order.

Field.Name: Custom Market Quantity Remaining
Field.Description: Volume remaining on custom market order after matching. If zero, custom market order has traded out and should be deleted.

Field.Name: Traded Contract Number
Field.Description: Contract Number Field Element Identifier of the underlying Order Book Traded.

Field.Name: Trade Side of Non-Custom Order
Field.Description: Side of non-custom order: “B” – is the Buyer, “S” – is the Seller.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays: “N” = non-printable or “Y” = printable.

Message.Name: Trade Cancellation Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever a trade is cancelled by exchange operations. This message does not affect any resting orders and is more for Information purposes. Adjustments to the Open, High, Low, Last will be performed as separate action using the Open, High, Low, Last Trade Adjustment message.

Message.Name: Equilibrium Price Auction Info Message
Message.Description: ASX Trade24 disseminates equilibrium prices during a price discovery period. As orders are added, modified, cancelled or deleted a message will be reported informing the market the potential opening price.

Field.Name: Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Price at which matching will occur.

Message.Name: Open, High, Low, Last Trade Adjustment Message
Message.Description: ASX Trade24 disseminates market trade price adjustments where the exchange operator modifies the open, high, low, last, last volume, total traded volume or total number of trades (usually due to a trade cancellation) or the product resets the open, high, low, last, last volume when it moves to the next session within the trade date. Each price is re-distributed with the Market Updates bitwise flags indicating which fields have been adjusted. This message is also issued during a snapshot download to enable the requestor to generate an up-to-date market image without having to regenerate from previous trades and market trade adjustment messages.

Message.Name: Market Settlement Message
Message.Description: ASX Trade24 disseminates settlement prices for all future and option contracts in two instalments, an interim and then a final. When the contract moves to the next trade date, the Future Symbol Directory or Option Symbol Directory message will reflect the final settlement price reported from the previous trade date in the prior day settlement field.

Field.Name: Settlement Price
Field.Description: Settlement Price as indicated by Settlement Type.

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Volatility (implied 3 decimal), if non-option value is zero.

Message.Name: Ad Hoc Text Message
Message.Description: ASX Trade24 disseminates text messages to inform the market of ad hoc events.

Message.Name: Request for Quote Message
Message.Description: ASX Trade24 disseminates anonymous non-custom RFQs from the market.

Message.Name: Anomalous Order Threshold Publish Message
Message.Description: ASX Trade24 reports this message to inform the market of setting, zeroing or adjusting the Extreme Trade Range price (ETR), the Anomalous Order Threshold price (AOT) and the associated ranges for a contract that requires Market Integrity Rules enforcement.

Field.Name: ETR Price
Field.Description: Extreme Trade Range price (ETR); if zero, MIR is not enforced.

Message.Name: Volume and Open Interest Message
Message.Description: ASX Trade24 disseminates volume and open interest information for each trade date. The VOI Trade Date indicates the trade date to which the information applies.

Field.Name: Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: Volume traded or cleared for the specified VOI trade date.

Field.Name: Open Interest
Field.Description: Number of open contracts at end of day for the specified VOI trade date.

Field.Name: VOI Trade Date
Field.Description: Trade date to which the VOI information applies.

Struct.Name: Contract Legs
Struct.Description: Contract Legs for Custom Market Order.

Field.Name: Contract Number
Field.Description: Contract Number Field Element Identifier of this leg.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of this leg: “B” – Buy Order, “S” – Sell Order.

Bitfield.Name: Market Updates
Bitfield.Description: Bitwise flags indicating which fields have been adjusted

Field.Name: Total Traded Volume and Total Trades
Field.Description: Total Traded Volume and Total Trades

Value.Name: Start
Value.Description: Messages will start for this Trade Date

Value.Name: Paused
Value.Description: System is Paused, note applies to all trade dates

Value.Name: Resumed
Value.Description: System is Resumed, note applies to all trade dates

Value.Name: Inactive
Value.Description: Inactive or deactivated single session option

Value.Name: Activated
Value.Description: Activated or re-activated single session option

Value.Name: Regulatory Halt
Value.Description: Regulatory Halt (an ad hoc price discovery)

Value.Name: Normal
Value.Description: Normal Trade, trade price matches both order prices

Value.Name: Crossing Normal
Value.Description: Crossing Normal Trade, trade price matches both order prices

Value.Name: Sweeping
Value.Description: Sweeping Trade, trade price matches resting order

Value.Name: Crossing Sweeping
Value.Description: Crossing Sweeping Trade, trade price matches resting order

Value.Name: Levelling
Value.Description: Levelling Trade, trade price may be different than price of resting order(s)

Value.Name: Crossing Levelling
Value.Description: Crossing Levelling Trade, trade price may be different than price of resting order(s)

Value.Name: Spread to Underlying
Value.Description: Spread-to-Underlying trade (price is based on the order of the underlying future, relating to intra, inter or custom matching with an outright order)

Value.Name: Crossing Spread to Underlying
Value.Description: Crossing Spread-to-Underlying trade (price is based on the order of the underlying future, relating to intra, inter or custom matching with an outright order)

Value.Name: Intra-Spread
Value.Description: Intra-Spread-to-Intra-Spread trade (price is based on the near contract’s prior day settlement)

Value.Name: Crossing Intra Spread
Value.Description: Crossing Intra-Spread-to-Intra-Spread trade (price is based on the near contract’s prior day settlement)

Value.Name: Inter Spread
Value.Description: Inter-Spread-to-Inter-Spread trade (price is based on the secondary’s contract’s prior day settlement)

Value.Name: Crossing Inter Spread
Value.Description: Crossing Inter-Spread-to-Inter-Spread trade (price is based on the secondary’s contract’s prior day settlement)
